outcome: Admission to special care baby unit (SCBU)
cohort: 100 pregnant women (50 with MSAF and 50 with clear amniotic fluid)
finding: MSAF was associated with a higher rate of instrumental or cesarean delivery, lower APGAR scores, increased SCBU admissions and duration of stay, and MAS compared to clear amniotic fluid.
mod_finding: MSAF was associated with a higher rate of instrumental or cesarean delivery compared to clear amniotic fluid.
